item.title: Lily Allen Scaling Down Fall 2026 Leg of North American West End Girl Tour From Arenas to Theaters: ‘We’ve Had to Make Some Adjustments’
item.description:
[Intro music fades out]
Host: Welcome to our music update! We've got some news for Lily Allen fans. The singer has made some changes to her upcoming North American tour in support of her album "West End Girl".
[Short music transition]
Host: Originally, Allen had planned to play a series of arena shows in the fall, but she's now downsized most of those shows to smaller venues like amphitheaters. Unfortunately, her planned stop in Montreal has been cancelled.
[Short music transition]
Host: Allen announced the changes on Instagram, saying she's excited to bring her album to fans in a more intimate setting. She also apologized to her fans in Montreal, saying she's "so sad" they won't be able to make it to the city this time.
[Short music transition]
Host: The updated tour schedule kicks off on September 3rd at Madison Square Garden in New York, followed by shows in Boston, Philadelphia, and Toronto, among other cities. Fans who already have tickets to the affected shows will be refunded and given access to a presale for the new venues.
[Short music transition]
Host: Allen has been playing her new album in chronological order on tour, and has been focusing on her latest work rather than her back catalog. The tour is set to wrap up on September 28th at the Orpheum in Vancouver.
[Outro music fades in]
Host: That's the latest on Lily Allen's tour. We'll keep you updated on any more changes. Thanks for tuning in!
